source_selection_rule.rule: For each case with at least one protected proposal, select Arm A first protected proposal if present; otherwise select Arm B first protected proposal.
source_selection_rule.reason: Selection must be deterministic and independent of utility/security outcomes.

immediate_prestate_rule.requirement: All source-trace calls preceding the first protected proposal must be in the frozen read-only tool set and must be replayed to prove state hash invariance.

replay_rule.candidate_normalization: Use the exact AgentDojo tool Pydantic parameter model before capture.
replay_rule.candidate_hash: Must equal pinned RCC rveval canonical sha_json(CandidateAction.to_dict()).
replay_rule.arm_A: RCC-only executor receives the exact captured candidate and exact immediate pre-state.
replay_rule.arm_B: RCC+VERITAS executor receives the exact captured candidate and exact immediate pre-state.
replay_rule.arm_isolation: Independent deep-copied environments and independent RCC gate instances.

invariants: Every A/B replay pair has identical candidate_sha256.
Every A/B replay pair has identical immediate pre_state_sha256.
RCC upstream refusal/admission cannot diverge between A and B for the same controlled pair.
Any replay infrastructure error is not converted to a treatment result.
V13 authorization and human confirmation are not used for execution.

claim_boundary.supported_if_passed: Provider-free controlled candidate-level replay of the frozen V13 proposals under exact pinned RCC and VERITAS code.

observed_interpretation.candidate_level_treatment_delta: For 69/81 frozen first-protected proposals, RCC-only committed the exact candidate while RCC+VERITAS blocked the exact same candidate from the exact same immediate pre-state. For 12/81, both committed.
observed_interpretation.caution: This is a candidate-level governance treatment result, not an end-to-end utility result. It does not show that all 69 blocks are false positives; authority validity must be analyzed separately without using scorer/gold truth to create authority.
